cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo ===DU-GIT===; du -sh .git
echo ===DU-TOP===; du -sh --max-depth=1 . 2>/dev/null | sort -rh
echo ===PACK-COUNT===; ls .git/objects/pack/*.pack 2>/dev/null | wc -l
echo ===PACK-TOTAL===; du -sh .git/objects/pack
echo ===COUNT-OBJECTS===; git count-objects -v
echo ===SHALLOW-FILE===; cat .git/shallow 2>/dev/null | wc -l
echo ===REMOTE-FETCH-CONFIG===; git config --get-all remote.origin.fetch; git config --get remote.origin.url
echo ===GC-AUTO===; git config --get gc.auto
echo ===CRONTAB===; sudo crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#"
echo ===DF===; df -h /
